settings.title: Material & Care
settings.content: Machine wash cold with like colors. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low. Do not iron decoration.

settings.title: Sustainability
settings.content: Made with recycled fibers and low-impact dyes in factories that meet our responsibility standards.

settings.delivery_copy: All orders are processed within 1-2 business days.
settings.delivery_text: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days and shipped with tracking, so you can follow your parcel from our door to yours.
settings.returns_copy: Shop with confidence with our 30-day free returns policy.
settings.returns_text: Anything not quite right can go back within 30 days of delivery, unworn and with its tags on. Reach out through the contact page and we will sort the rest.

settings.question: What payment methods can I use?
settings.answer: We offer 35 different payment methods including major providers like Mastercard, Visa, PayPal, American Express and Diners as well as many different local payment methods including Klarna, iDEAL, AliPay, Sofort, giropay, and many more.

settings.question: Can I make changes to my order after it's been placed?
settings.answer: Once an order is placed we start processing it right away, so changes are only possible within the first hour. Contact support as soon as possible and we will do our best.

settings.question: Do you offer e-gift cards for international customers?
settings.answer: Yes, e-gift cards are delivered by email and can be redeemed at checkout from anywhere in the world.

settings.question: How To Return My Items?
settings.answer: Start a return from your account within 30 days of delivery. Print the prepaid label, pack the items and drop the parcel at your nearest service point.

settings.question: Will you ship to a P.O box address?
settings.answer: We ship to P.O. boxes with standard delivery. Express options require a street address.

settings.question: Can all items be shipped in one package?
settings.answer: We combine items into as few packages as possible. Items shipped from different warehouses may arrive separately.

settings.question: Package not received
settings.answer: Check the tracking link first — carriers sometimes mark parcels early. If it has not arrived within 3 business days of the delivery date, contact our support team.
